enemy.name: Hero's Call
enemy.flavour_text: In the floral fragrance of the land of heroes, even simple stone columns seem to invite you to become a hero. It is a desire deeply rooted in every heart, and perhaps an opportunity is all that is needed to see it.

abilities.text: Periodically spawns inside an Immersed Operator's Attack Range
Can only be attacked by and is prioritized by Immersed Operators
Disappears after taking a certain number of attacks
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter
